name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: CRM & Lead Management | Marketing Operations, Automation & Lead Lifecycle

Hands-on across Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, with strict data-hygiene practice behind every build. Currently deploying AI agents inside CRM workflows for lead qualification, enrichment, and company research, the same direction this role is heading.
